name: push_cart
text: A person steadily walks straight forward pushing a shopping cart, with both hands continuously on the cart handle in front of the abdomen. Elbows relaxed and bent, forearms extending forward. Regular alternating walking steps, upright torso, maintain both grips, no turning or releasing.
